verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents passing a JSON schema to get schema-conformant structured output. The closest item is a URL fetch that converts pages into "HTML, JSON or markdown", which is output-format conversion rather than schema-guided extraction. Stagehand's natural-language selectors and the agent data-pulling claims likewise never mention a schema parameter. The axis clearly applies to a browser-agent and web-extraction platform, so the absence of evidence is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a JSON schema so the API returns structured data matching that schema
